title: RayCAD operation template
description: One operation template of a library, the file templates/<uuid>.optemplate.json (PLAN.md 3.6, libraries.h OpTemplate): a saved operation with its tool query and parameters, keyed by the feature it is for. Values in toolQuery and params may be expressions over feature.* and tool.* (with or without a leading '$'). Unknown keys are allowed and are kept when RayCAD saves the template again.

schema.description: Version of this file's format. A larger value means a newer RayCAD wrote it.

material.description: Material id, or null for any.

machine.description: Machine id, or null for any.

params.description: Operation parameters as the operation type's schema defines them.
